fact: The Council of Ministers of 22 October 2026 adopted a decree on the conditions of computerised processing of civil-status data, the civil-status identifier and interoperability, applying law n°012-2025/ALT, providing for systematic registration of births, marriages and deaths, electronic archiving of registers and online issuance of acts; no implementation calendar was given.
title: État civil en ligne : le Burkina pose le cadre d'une reforme déjà commencée
